categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifies the acquisition of particular land parcels, describes their boundaries and extents, and authorizes the taking of possession by the Acquiring Officer. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or detailed portfolio assignments that would fall under Types 1-3.
